title: Obsolete fact, not replaced: the update comes first everywhere
what: The obsolete-fact test (an outdated statement in the retrieved context; arXiv 2610.36308). A fact is written, then a later note says it changed, in different words, and nobody replaces or edits the old note. Search, the 'what is relevant' lookup and the SessionStart injection must all put the current value in front of the agent, and search must rank it first. The old note is still there (Monomem never hides a note by guessing), so this scenario does not check that the old value is absent; A34 does, with the replace step.

steps.title: {{proj}} build server moved
steps.body: Update: {{proj}} builds moved off the old box; the build server is now {{v2}}.

expect.desc: search ranks the update above the obsolete note
the 'what is relevant' lookup ranks the update first
the SessionStart injection carries the current value
